step1_analysis.description: A single-stage fully differential operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) utilizing a current-mirror topology. The differential input pair steers current into diode-connected NMOS loads, which is then mirrored to the output nodes loaded by PMOS current sources.

paper_reference.title: A 1-V 140-W 88-dB Audio Sigma-Delta Modulator in 90-nm CMOS

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm1 * (ro3 || ro4). Assuming Itail=20uA, gm1 ~ 100uS, Rout ~ 500kOhm -> Gain ~ 50 V/V = 34 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on typical gm/Id and intrinsic gain (gm*ro) of sky130 devices at L=0.5um.

sky130_expected.calculation: UGBW = gm1 / (2*pi*Cload). With gm1=100uS and Cload=1pF, UGBW = 16 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the chosen load capacitance (1pF used in testbench) and tail current.

phase_margin.description: Phase margin at unity gain frequency

sky130_expected.calculation: Single stage OTA with 1pF load is dominated by the output pole. Non-dominant poles at current mirror nodes are at high frequencies.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Current mirror pole is at gm2/Cgs2 (~1.5 GHz), well above the UGBW, ensuring excellent phase margin.
Calculated from bias voltages and device dimensions in the netlist.
Maximum output current is limited by the tail current mirrored to the output.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC gain, UGBW, phase margin, power, and slew rate of the fully differential current-mirror OTA. Includes an ideal CMFB loop to stabilize the output common-mode voltage.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Fully Differential Current-Mirror OTA Testbench

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u

* DUT
XM5 N1 LABEL_NET_0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM4 OUTN LABEL_NET_1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM7 N0 N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM2 N2 N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM1 N2 INN N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM6 OUTP N0 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM3 OUTN N2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM8 OUTP LABEL_NET_3 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 N0 INP N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}

* Power Supply
VVDD VDD 0 1.8

* Tail Bias (~20uA)
VLABEL_NET_0 LABEL_NET_0 0 1.1

* Ideal CMFB for Load Bias (Stabilizes output common-mode to 0.9V)
B_SUM OUT_SUM 0 V=V(OUTP)+V(OUTN)
V_REF VCM_REF 0 1.8
B_CMFB1 LABEL_NET_1 0 V=1.18 + 10*(V(OUT_SUM) - V(VCM_REF))
B_CMFB3 LABEL_NET_3 0 V=1.18 + 10*(V(OUT_SUM) - V(VCM_REF))

* Inputs (DC=0.9V, AC=1V diff, Pulse for Slew Rate)
VINP INP 0 DC 0.9 AC 0.5 PULSE(0.9 1.4 10n 1n 1n 5u 10u)
VINN INN 0 DC 0.9 AC -0.5 PULSE(0.9 0.4 10n 1n 1n 5u 10u)

* Load Capacitors
CL1 OUTP 0 1p
CL2 OUTN 0 1p

* Differential Output
B_OUT_DIFF OUT_DIFF 0 V=V(OUTP)-V(OUTN)

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* 2. AC Analysis (Gain, UGBW, Phase Margin)
ac dec 100 1 1G
let gain_db = vdb(OUT_DIFF)
let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(OUT_DIFF))
meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
meas ac ugbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
meas ac phase_at_ugbw find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
let pm = 180 + phase_at_ugbw
print dc_gain ugbw pm

* 3. Transient Analysis (Slew Rate)
tran 10n 10u
* Measure time for a 1V differential change (0.1V to 1.1V) to avoid railing issues
meas tran t_rise trig v(OUT_DIFF) val=0.1 rise=1 targ v(OUT_DIFF) val=1.1 rise=1
let sr_rise_vus = (1.0 / t_rise) * 1e-6
meas tran t_fall trig v(OUT_DIFF) val=1.1 fall=1 targ v(OUT_DIFF) val=0.1 fall=1
let sr_fall_vus = (1.0 / t_fall) * 1e-6
print sr_rise_vus sr_fall_vus

quit
.endc
.end
